title: hibiscus populifolius
intro: Hibiscus populifolius, commonly known as the Red Cotton Tree or White Siris, is a species of flowering plant in the mallow family Malvaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce cholesterol levels, and act as a diuretic to alleviate symptoms of edema and urinary tract infections. The therapeutic actions of Hibiscus populifolius are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and polyphenols, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
